source.title: Atlas challenge: website on main — 7 fixes before launch (PR #3 review)
source.body:
## Atlas challenge: website is on main now — 7 fixes before launch (PR #3 review)

PR #3 was merged into main (`f79c943d`, head now `d83779dd`) while this review was being written, so these findings now sit on main, one step from Bluehost. I read the full draft — `src/data.py`, `src/build.py`, `src/site.js`, generated `index/stones/finder/drop/shop/order/about` + `p/earth-circle.html` — and verified it against main and the locked brand assets. The honesty engine holds; this is a strong draft. Fix the items below before it goes live.

### Verified good
- **No woo-woo, no medical claims anywhere.** Proven / Traditional / Care / We never claim labels on every stone and product page; piezoelectric + the honest "conductive" correction are accurate; footer disclaimer is right. FAQ answers are straight.
- **Logo is the locked one.** `assets/davias-logo.webp` on main is byte-identical (sha256 `32cbf89e…`) to the Nov 8 locked logo, and `build.py` correctly downscales it to `website/site/davias-logo.webp` (1200x800) plus favicon/og-image. "Earth Circle — the bracelet from our logo" is literally true.
- **Cord claim is now checkable.** `BRACELET_CORD_OPTIONS.md` exists on main; `data.py`'s nylon-coated stainless beading wire + solid metal clasp matches its top recommendation. That closes the cord half of issue #2.
- **Nothing invented.** All 13 products "Ask for price"; no drop dates; order bag + drop list are honest mailto flows with no fake backend or checkout. `data.js` matches `data.py` exactly (6 stones, 13 products, all prices null).

### To fix
**1. Owner question — "Made by Octavia, by hand": confirm the timing before launch.** The claim is everywhere: hero "strung one bead at a time by Octavia", every product page "Made by: Octavia, by hand", about "Designs and makes every piece by hand", "Octavia makes each piece by hand, so no two are exactly alike", shop "Octavia takes custom requests", finder CTA "Ask Octavia to make it". CURRENT_TASK.md confirms her role as maker, so this is a timing check, not a dispute: if Octavia is making pieces right now, this is closed. If production starts later (or David makes them meanwhile), buyers will read "made by" as right-now — the site should say "Designed by Octavia" until she is actually making them. Do not go live with this wording until the owner confirms which it is.
**2. Earth Circle care contradicts itself.** The Care block concatenates every stone's care text, so one bracelet says both "Mild soap and water is fine" and "Keep it dry. Gypsum slowly dissolves in water." A buyer can't tell whether to wash it. Fix: lead with the softest stone's rule ("Keep it dry — one bead is selenite, Mohs 2") and separate per-stone care. Same tension: Earth Circle is a selenite-bead bracelet with no "special occasions" note, while the FAQ says selenite is for special occasions; Soft Light anklet says "keep it out of the water" but anklets are sold as the "beach-ready" type. Pick one framing per piece.
**3. Finder selenite edge case.** The demote in `site.js` only moves selenite to the end of the ranked list. When only two stones score (e.g. white + clarity + every day), the combo is still "Clear Quartz + Selenite" for everyday wear, with only a warning note. The PR body says the finder "steers selenite to accent" — it doesn't fully. Fix: when wear = every day, exclude selenite from the 2-stone combo and show it only as a "for special occasions" extra.
**4. Drop reads as live before the payment path exists (issue #1, still open).** Homepage "This month's drop", drop page "This month's design", "Drops sell out", "Once a month. One design. Then it's gone." No date is set and payment is TBD (open decision #2). The "opening date is announced first to the drop list" line softens it, but the page reads like a live drop. Keep "coming soon" framing until a date + payment method are settled. (Also: "Founders Drops are numbered, 1 to 100" is a new claim — fine if numbering is actually planned, just confirm.)
**5. Beach sourcing (issue #2, still open).** "Beach: shells & starfish" is a coming-soon theme with no sourcing line. Before any beach piece is listed: real vs faux, supplier, dyed/treated labeling. Note the homepage "100% natural stone beads" will need a carve-out once shells (not stone) join the shop.
**6. Hygiene: `website/src/__pycache__/data.cpython-313.pyc` is committed.** Remove it and add a `.gitignore` for `__pycache__/`.
**7. Minor wording:** "Golden Thread — Looks far more expensive than it is." With no price set anywhere, the comparison is empty; drop the line or set the price first.

Items 1 and 4 block going live; 2 and 3 should land before the first real order. Nothing here blocks the preview.
